top_signals.title: Eni's Profits Soar 125% as Refining Boom Fuels Massive Investor Payouts
top_signals.summary: Italian energy group Eni is boosting its payout to investors with an extraordinary dividend and increased share buybacks after more than doubling its third-quarter earnings on higher oil and gas production and soaring refining margins. Eni’s adjusted net profit more than doubled from a year earlier to $3.14 billion (2.8 billion euros) for the third quarter, driven by higher oil and gas production and realizations and more than doubled refining margins across its operations, the Italian company said on Friday. The profit topped consensus estimates…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: AI IPOs Stall While Private Markets Heat Up
top_signals.summary: AI IPOs are hitting the brakes as public markets cool. But with private money still flowing to giants like OpenAI and DeepSeek, companies might be tempted to stay private for longer. Anthony Stephens has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
